claims.claim: These 2 books are perfect combo for intentional people, who don't just want to be at the top but...
claims.evidence: This is a marketing/sales pitch, not a verifiable condition claim; no photo shows internal pages, spine, or back cover to confirm 'perfect' condition.

risks.risk: Internal page condition (yellowing, markings, missing pages, highlighting)
risks.proof: Clear photo or short video flipping through the pages of both books

risks.risk: Spine and back cover condition (cracks, tears, creasing)
risks.proof: Photo of spine and back cover for each book

risks.risk: Edition or printing year unknown, affects collector/resale value
risks.proof: Photo of copyright page showing edition and year
risks.if_unproven: price as unknown/older edition, lower tier

risks.risk: Water damage, odor, or mustiness not visible in front-cover photos
risks.proof: Close-up photos of pages near binding and a video pan showing no warping

risks.risk: Books could be used copies misrepresented as new given bookshop watermark suggests resale stock
risks.proof: Photo showing original purchase receipt or 'new' sticker if any

proof_requests: Photo of back covers of both books
Photo of spine of both books
Video flipping through pages of both books to show internal condition
Photo of copyright/edition page for each book
Close-up of any writing, highlighting, or stamps inside
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item as two specific paperback books, allowing a worst-case used-condition price; no fraud indicators are present, just unverified condition details.
